rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The Certificate of Election of Congress President certifies that Smt. Sonia Gandhi has been duly elected unopposed as President of the Indian National Congress on 3 September 2010 under Article XVIII of the Congress Constitution and the Organisational Election Schedule 2010; it is signed by Oscar Fernandes as Returning Officer for Election of Congress President, New Delhi, 03/09/2010.
